headline: Chris Brown is getting love for showing support to viral artist Ellison “Red” Anderson! Ac
body: Chris Brown is getting love for showing support to viral artist Ellison “Red” Anderson! According to reports, Breezy surprised the talented musician, who has experienced homelessness, with brand-new music gear and a new phone. But the biggest surprise? Chris reportedly saved his PERSONAL NUMBER in the phone so they could stay connected and potentially work on music together in the future. A moment that could open some major doors for Red!
